description: REQUIRES prior gov24__session__login call with same account_link_id. This writes to the institution. The first call is not executed: it returns a preview of exactly what will be sent and a one-time confirmation_token (error WRITE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED). Show that preview to the user as it is. Only after the user agrees, call again with the same arguments plus that confirmation_token. Never add the token without the user's agreement. Changing any argument makes the token invalid; call without the token to get a new preview. Returns a download link for the issued certificate. pre_consent must be true. Files: the document the institution issued, unchanged, as PDF, listed in artifacts[] of the result with a download_url that works for 15 minutes; each file is kept for 7 days. If a link has expired, call xdata__job__result with the job_id from the result for fresh links.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

business_address.description: Workplace address as the institution address finder returns it.

confirmation_token.description: One-time confirmation token returned by the first call (error WRITE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED). Send it back unchanged with the same arguments to execute; it expires in 10 minutes and works once.

payment_recipient.description: Optional. Named recipient other than the taxpayer.

phone.description: Contact number, split the way the institution form takes it.

pre_consent.description: Must be true. Confirms the prior consent.
